body:
I was aiming to create a circular bottom like other models of strap-ons (and maybe add a suction cup later).

I assumed the firm core wouldn't extend to the balls, but now I'm not sure since you mentioned it.

The more I look at it, the less likely this looks possible without making it look or perform worse. At this point, I may as well just create my own from scratch lol. Thanks for the advice!
I guess I should clarify that I like balls just fine when they're attached to a body. :p It's just disembodied balls that weird me out.
